children: Indian shares opened lower on Wednesday as a fresh escalation in the Middle East conflict had Brent crude hurtling toward $100 per barrel, a pain point for the world's third-largest crude oil importer.

Ten of the 16 major sectors logged losses.

The Middle East war intensified on Tuesday with Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen launching strikes on several Saudi cities, further embroiling a U.S. ally in the conflict, while U.S. forces hit multiple Iranian oil tankers and Iran struck a U.S. base in Jordan.
